project.name: Markdown site
project.description: Inspect and query an article, repair typed YAML metadata and preview its HTML, then build a portable folder-based Markdown + CEM-ML site with exact static assets and source provenance.

entries.name: Build and preview site
entries.description: Build four Markdown documents with shared CEM-ML layouts and publish CSS, an image and a download. Choose generated/index.html in Preview artifact.

entries.name: Validate article metadata
entries.description: Validate saved Markdown source and opt-in YAML front matter, including typed weight metadata.

entries.name: Preview Markdown article
entries.description: Convert the saved article body to exact HTML without front matter. Relative links and images are published as references; use the full site build for its assets and shared layout.

entries.name: Inspect Markdown source events
entries.description: Inspect native Markdown source events and original ranges before HTML lowering. Preview Markdown article remains the generated HTML presentation; this event projection is not a complete Markdown language AST.

entries.name: Query the generated article outline
entries.description: Query the generated HTML heading, image/link counts and image reference through an explicit caller-bound XHTML prefix; metadata title remains a separate layout input.

entries.name: Repair the article metadata type
entries.description: An intentional weight string violates the opt-in native metadata contract. Inspect the original source range, replace it with an integer, save and revalidate.
